findings.title: Nested activity windows repeatedly recompute the same session summaries
findings.what: ROLLUP_WINDOWS.map filters the full ordered session list for each of four nested windows, then lines 296-324 recompute composeSessionSummary and rescan every matching session's tool calls. A session in the last hour is therefore summarized and tool-aggregated four times per rollup request. The subsequent per-window sorts repeat over the same nested population as well.
findings.fix: Precompute each session's summary and tool contribution once, then accumulate those prepared rows into the applicable windows in one pass; retain per-window maps and bounded notable-session selection.
findings.acceptance: Add an instrumented test with sessions shared by all four windows and assert compose/aggregation work occurs once per session while every existing rollup result remains deeply equal; a benchmark or probe should show linear session/tool traversal rather than four repeated traversals.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarial second pass re-read src/lib/session-summaries.ts:265-360 and the overlapping-window tests at src/lib/session-summaries.test.ts:180-273. The windows are nested, and no memoization or precomputed summary exists before the per-window map, so repeated filtering, summary composition, tool scanning, and sorting are present in the audited baseline.
